as_told.title: Gordon Novel and the burning of 555 Camp Street

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, tells Jesse Michels' podcast about a man named Gordon Novel. Sheehan says Novel was arrested and prosecuted by Jim Garrison, the New Orleans prosecutor who investigated the killing of President Kennedy, for burning down 555 Camp Street, an office building that Sheehan connects to Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of shooting Kennedy, and to Guy Banister. If true, it would suggest someone wanted evidence at that office destroyed.
